# Lonny Lot

> Personal site of Lonny Lot (Lonny Kapelushnik) — engineer and builder at lonnylot.com.

Lonny builds playful software, web experiments, and practical tools. This site is a simple hub linking to public projects and social presence.

## Site

- [Home](https://lonnylot.com/): Landing page with project links and social profile
- [robots.txt](https://lonnylot.com/robots.txt): Crawler policy (allow all)
- [llms.txt](https://lonnylot.com/llms.txt): This file — machine-readable overview for LLMs and agents

## Projects

- [Space Cadet](https://space-cadet.lonnylot.com/): Web pinball remake inspired by 3D Pinball for Windows — Space Cadet. Flippers, missions, no login required.
- [macOS 27 — Golden Gate](https://macos27.lonnylot.com/): Interactive browser recreation of macOS 27 with responsive Liquid Glass UI and native-style apps.
- [Is it SOTA?](https://isitsota.com/): Fully automatic AI state-of-the-art tracker — dated verdicts per category on whether a model is SOTA, computed from independent primary evidence. Run by Lare, LLC.
- [Quiet Neighbor](https://github.com/lonnylot/QuietNeighbor): Open-source (MIT) per-app volume mixer for Mac, written in Swift.
